name.description: The human-readable name of the rule component.

delegate_descriptor_id.description: The descriptor ID identifying the component type from an extension package.

order.description: The execution order within its type group.

rule_order.description: The order relative to other components in the rule.

settings.description: A JSON-encoded string of settings for the component.

timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the component.

delay_next.description: Whether to delay the next action.

negate.description: Whether to negate the condition result.

enabled.description: Whether the rule component is enabled.
